quotas.title: Quotas
quotas.lead: How many jobs can run at once and how long a single job may take.
quotas.concurrentInvalid: A whole number from 1 to 1000, or empty.

concurrent.title: Concurrent jobs
concurrent.lead: Builds and checks running at the same time. An empty field removes the limit.

userConcurrent.label: Per person
userConcurrent.hint: The rest of the person's jobs wait in the queue.

orgConcurrent.label: Per organization
orgConcurrent.hint: A shared limit for all members of one organization.

duration.title: Run time
duration.label: Any job time limit
duration.hint: From 0.5 to 1440 minutes; an empty field removes the limit. PDF builds also have their own limit in Installation: the smaller of the two applies.

explain.title: What happens when a limit is reached

queue.title: The job waits instead of being rejected
queue.body: A new job joins the queue and starts as soon as the person or organization has a free slot.

timeout.title: A long job is stopped
timeout.body: A job running past the limit is interrupted with the "Timed out" state. The person can start it again.

scope.title: Limits for people and organizations
scope.body: Defaults apply to everyone. A limit for a single person or organization is set below, under overrides.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.lead: A limit set for a person or an organization beats the default. A person gets the organization's value when they have none of their own.
overrides.ownerPlaceholder: Find a person or an organization

usageAdmin.title: Usage
usageAdmin.lead: Installation totals for the current period (since {{date}}) and the use of a chosen person or organization.
usageAdmin.loadFailed: Could not load the owner's usage.
